item.title: Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for intensified pressure on Russia to end its war against Ukraine, arguing that Moscow continues to incur massive losses while prolonging a conflict whose consequences are increasingly being felt far beyond the battlefield.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Security Council LIVE: World leaders debate ongoing war in Ukraine
item.description: Five years of war. Another winter closing in. Today, the Security Council once again debates a path to peace – though any resolution still runs up against the veto of Russia, one of its own permanent members, whose objections have repeatedly stalled any consensus. As world leaders take the floor, the gap between diplomatic process and battlefield reality appears to be stark.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: United Kingdom announces action on disinformation and global AI standards
item.description: The United Kingdom will fight disinformation at home and abroad, and work to ensure global safety standards for artificial intelligence (AI), new Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday evening in his first address to the United Nations General Assembly.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: ‘Nowhere is safe’: UN experts detail Ukraine war’s toll and Russia’s reach beyond its borders
item.description: UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts on Monday laid out a grim picture of the human cost of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, with a spotlight on civilians facing a third wartime winter as well as the intimidation of Russians who have fled abroad.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Sexual violence against civilians and POWs in Ukraine widespread and ‘abhorrent’
item.description: Over 1,000 cases of sexual violence against civilians and prisoners of war (POWs) in Ukraine have been documented from the start of Russia’s invasion to the end of July this year.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ukraine: Attacks on education threaten an entire generation, UNICEF warns
item.description: In an underground classroom in Sumy, Ukraine, children sit quietly at their desks, busy with the day’s lessons. For the moment they are shielded from the horrors of nearly five years of war, but just barely.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ukraine: Drone attacks on Chornobyl are ‘gambling with the safety of millions of people’
item.description: A drone strike on the protective structure at the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant could have endangered the safety of millions of people, UN Development Programme (UNDP) Administrator Alexander De Croo told reporters via video link from Kyiv on Thursday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: As wildfires spread north, UN agencies race to help Europe adapt
item.description: As the climate warms, the threat of wildfires is spreading in Europe. How can historically cooler and wetter countries prepare?
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Repeated attacks on humanitarian warehouses put vital medical aid at risk in Ukraine: WHO
item.description: A new airstrike overnight damaged one of the main warehouses used by the World Health Organization (WHO) in Ukraine to store humanitarian medical supplies in the Kyiv region, the UN agency said on Friday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: WHO reports more than 3,200 attacks on Ukraine’s healthcare system since full-scale invasion
item.description: Since the beginning of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, 3,205 attacks on healthcare facilities have been carried out, World Health Organization (WHO) Representative for Ukraine Jarno Habicht reported on Friday following fresh overnight strikes.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Security Council LIVE: Civilian suffering grows in Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: As spiralling drone and missile attacks on civilians in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war continue, top UN officials told the Security Council on Monday that every diplomatic effort must work towards a full, immediate and unconditional ceasefire. UN News app users can follow our live coverage here.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Russian missiles kill 17 more in Ukraine as Guterres calls for ceasefire
item.description: Russian ballistic missile strikes killed 17 people and injured more than 40 in and around the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Thursday, local authorities reported.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: ‘Warned but not protected’: Four in ten adults in England ignore heat alerts
item.description: As amber heat-health alerts spread across England this summer, a new study has found that the warnings are being received – but not changing behaviour.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties hit highest level since March 2022
item.description: Civilian casualties in Ukraine reached their highest monthly level in July, with more people killed and injured than at any time since March 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in the country, HRMMU, said in an update on Thursday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Humanitarian aid warehouses come under attack in Ukraine
item.description: Russia’s ongoing full-scale invasion of Ukraine has left civilians vulnerable to repeated deadly attacks and humanitarian workers and key facilities being targeted and destroyed.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: The Mediterranean’s own odyssey: An ecological treasure feels the strain
item.description: More than 2,500 years after Homer’s epic was first told, Christopher Nolan's blockbuster retelling of The Odyssey has brought the journey back to big screens worldwide. But, behind the sweeping plot is another character facing an odyssey of its own: the Mediterranean Sea.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Peacock party takes pride of place in nod to decades of turbulent history
item.description: In a new twist on panda diplomacy, UN Geneva welcomed five young peacocks to the Palace of Nations on Friday, a gift of India that preserves a tradition of keeping the stately birds in the grounds, that predates both the global body and its ill-fated predecessor, the League of Nations.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: ‘A clear violation’: Guterres deplores deadliest attack on Kyiv this year
item.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres condemned on Wednesday the deadliest Russian strikes on Kyiv this year, which killed 17 people and caused extensive damage to civilian infrastructure overnight.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: UN reports deadly month for Ukrainian civilians as Russian attacks intensify
item.description: Russian forces hammered Ukraine with ballistic missiles and long-range drones overnight on Tuesday, killing at least 17 civilians – mainly around Kyiv – and injuring another 44, the UN human rights office in Ukraine reported.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: As Russia’s invasion of Ukraine continues, with both sides stepping up airstrikes and drone attacks in recent weeks deep inside each other's territory, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) appealed on Tuesday for greater protection for the war’s youngest victims.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Recovery in Ukraine, one life at a time
item.description: In classrooms, maternity wards, hospital corridors and local communities across Ukraine, people are rebuilding their lives despite the ongoing war.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Attacks ‘getting worse’: Deadly Russian strikes hit Ukrainian cities
item.description: Aid workers and first responders raced to help people across Ukraine after a wave of deadly Russian missile and drone strikes overnight as concerns mounted over military activity near nuclear power plants on Thursday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Cyprus: Guterres calls for renewed trust and a new meeting on the way forward
item.description: The United Nations Secretary-General said on Wednesday that he plans to convene fresh talks on Cyprus to resolve the decades-long division on the Mediterranean island, stressing that the moment calls for rebuilding trust between its two communities.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Security Council LIVE: Briefing on Ukraine as deadly Russian strikes hit cities and ports
item.description: The UN Security Council met on Monday at Ukraine’s request, following recent large-scale Russian attacks on Kyiv and elsewhere. At least one civilian was killed and more than a dozen wounded in an overnight strike on the capital on 19 July that also damaged homes and civilian infrastructure. Ukrainian authorities described it as one of the largest and most intense attacks since the invasion began. Follow live updates below.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: After war took her leg, this Ukrainian gymnast refused to give up
item.description: When 10-year-old Ukrainian gymnast Sasha Paskal stepped onto the stage in New York's Times Square this week, she carried a message far bigger than her performance.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Wildfires surge across Europe as Spain and France battle major blazes
item.description: The amount of land burned by wildfires across Europe has increased by 57 per cent in four years, according to new data from the World Health Organization (WHO) in Europe.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ukraine: Deadly Russian attacks severely damage aid warehouses
item.description: Russian attacks and drone strikes killed at least two children and injured dozens more across Ukraine over recent days while severely damaging three critical aid warehouses, UN agencies reported on Monday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ukraine: UN condemns overnight attack on Kyiv
item.description: United Nations agencies have deplored a fresh Russian assault on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv which left at least one person dead and a dozen injured.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: ‘Heat deaths are not inevitable’: WHO pushes Europe to heat‑proof its hospitals
item.description: As Europe battles a deadly record-breaking heatwave, the World Health Organization (WHO) issued new guidance on Thursday to help countries face scorching temperatures now and in the future.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Independent expert urges UK leaders to uphold Supreme Court ruling on women’s rights
item.description: A UN independent human rights expert has urged political leaders in the United Kingdom to support implementation of a Supreme Court ruling on the legal definition of sex, warning that opposition to updated equality guidance risks weakening protections for women and girls.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories
